# Billing implementation — current status

     billing implementation across Stripe (web) and RevenueCat (native mobile).

**Last verified:** 07/25/2026, Android emulator (`Pixel_8`), RevenueCat **Test Store**,
account `vampirel1988@gmail.com`, org `Jason Liang` (`cd138a09-…`, 7 units).

**Headline:** the native (RevenueCat) purchase path is **verified working end to end** —
plan selection → store purchase → entitlement → backend sync → correct price, interval
and voice quota in the UI. Stripe (web) remains the untested path.

---

## 1. Tier design (as implemented and verified)

| | Free | Normal | Pro |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly | $0 | $1.99 / unit | $2.99 / unit |
| Yearly | $0 | $19.99 / unit | $29.00 / unit |
| Voice conversions | **3 flat / month** | **10 per unit / month** | **30 per unit / month** |
| Tax-ready PDF export | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Units | unlimited | unlimited | unlimited |
| Entitlement id | *(none)* | `normal_access` | `pro_access` |

Billing is **account-level with per-unit pricing**: once paid, every unit in the org is
billed — `price = amount_per_unit_cents × total_unit_count` — and entitlements (voice quota,
exports) apply account-wide. Voice quota is **flat 3/month on Free** but **scales per unit on
paid tiers**. Verified live on the 7-unit `Jason Liang` org:

- Free → `0/3` voice conversions (flat, ignores unit count) ✅
- Pro yearly → **$29.00 × 7 = $203.00 / year** and **30 × 7 = 210** voice conversions ✅

(The $203 figure is correct by design, per `pricing_research.md` line 39, not a bug.)

## 2. RevenueCat dashboard configuration — DONE

Project `97a79870`, **Test Store** app `app0ab9e1d5db`.

- **Entitlements:** `normal_access`, `pro_access`
- **Products:** `normal_monthly` $1.99 · `normal_yearly` $19.99 · `pro_monthly` $2.99 ·
  `pro_yearly` $29.00 — each attached to its matching entitlement
- **Offerings (one per plan, deliberately):**
  - `default` → display name "Rentzu Normal" — `$rc_monthly`→`normal_monthly`,
    `$rc_annual`→`normal_yearly`
  - `pro` → "Rentzu Pro" — `$rc_monthly`→`pro_monthly`, `$rc_annual`→`pro_yearly`

  RevenueCat offering identifiers are **immutable**, so Normal had to stay in the
  pre-created `default` offering. `revenueCat.ts` carries an explicit `normal → default`
  fallback map for this.

## 4. Bugs found and fixed

1. **Pro purchases bought the Normal product.** `getCurrentOfferingPackages()` returned only
   `offerings.current` (= `default` = Normal) and package matching used `||`, so selecting
   Pro silently purchased Normal. → Replaced with `getOfferingPackagesForPlan(plan)`, which
   resolves the plan's own offering, and matching now keys on `packageType`.
   *Verified:* Test Store dialog showed `pro_yearly` / $29.00.
2. **Null-deref crash on the Account screen.** `billingOverview?.plan !== 'free'` is `true`
   while `billingOverview` is `null` (`undefined !== 'free'`); once `nativeBillingActive`
   became true this branch dereferenced `billingOverview!.amount_per_unit_cents` and the app
   white-screened. → Added a `hasPaidPlan` guard.
3. **Yearly subs displayed monthly pricing.** `apply_revenuecat_entitlement_state` never
   updated `billing_interval` from the purchased product. → Added
   `_interval_from_product_id()`. *Verified:* DB shows `billing_interval='year'`.
4. **Database was 9 columns behind the models.** `plan`, `billing_interval`,
   `voice_quota_period_start`, `voice_used_this_period`, `billing_provider` and all four
   `revenuecat_*` columns were missing, so `GET /billing/overview` returned **500** and the
   whole plan card silently rendered from `null` — no tier chips, no quota line. Root cause:
   the app uses `Base.metadata.create_all()`, which creates missing *tables* but never adds
   missing *columns*, and the two SQL files in `schema_updates/` had never been applied.
   → Applied `2026-07-18-organization-billing-plan-tiers.sql` and
   `2026-07-25-organization-billing-add-revenuecat.sql` (both idempotent).
   **Any other environment/DB needs these applied too.**
5. **`react-native-purchases` was 7.28.1**, which predates the RevenueCat Test Store and
   rejected the key outright (*"The specified API Key is not recognized… should look like
   `goog_…`"*). → Upgraded to **8.12.0** (peer `react-native >= 0.73`, fine on SDK 51) and
   rebuilt the dev client. Our wrapper's API surface was unchanged; `tsc --noEmit` clean.
6. **Test-skill helper bug:** `Dismiss-RentzuMetroOverlay` called `SelectSingleNode` on the
   string path returned by `Get-UiDump`. → Now parses via `Read-XmlDump` first.
7. **Plan card kept showing the old plan after a successful purchase.** The Plan card lives on
   the Account tab, but the `/billing/overview` effect in `App.tsx` had deps
   `[organizationId, screen, homeRefreshKey]` — **not** `homeTab` — so entering the Account tab
   never refetched. `purchaseSelectedPlanNative` *did* call `setBillingOverview(...)`, but the
   native store sheet backgrounds/recreates the activity, so that mount-time fetch (still
   "Free") outlived the post-sync state update. Ruled out a backend cause first: calling
   `sync_revenuecat_entitlement` directly returns the correct `plan=pro / $203.00`, so the
   response body was never stale. → Added `homeTab` to the effect deps, an `AppState` "active"
   listener that bumps `homeRefreshKey` on foreground, a `homeRefreshKey` bump after both
   purchase and restore, and a `cancelled` guard so a slow in-flight fetch can't clobber newer
   state. *Verified:* reset the org to Free, repurchased Pro/yearly, card flipped to **Pro /
   $203.00 per year / 0-of-210 / "Manage subscription"** with **no app restart**.

```
billing_provider          = 'revenuecat'

```

App UI after refresh: badge **Pro**, **$203.00 / year**, "$29.00 per unit / year, 7 units
billed via the App Store/Play Store", **Voice conversions: 0/210**, button **Manage

The org id is used directly as the RevenueCat **app user id**, so a webhook resolves to an
organization with no alias table.

## 6. Known open issues

1. **Benign console error on Test Store purchases:**
   `com.revenuecat.purchases.Store does not contain element with name 'test_store'`. This is
   inside RevenueCat's own Android SDK deserializing the optional `SubscriptionInfo` blob;
   entitlements are unaffected and the purchase completes correctly. It will disappear on a
   real Play Store build.
2. **Expo SDK 51 native libs are not 16 KB page-aligned**, which Google Play now requires.
   An **Expo SDK upgrade (51 → 52+) is mandatory before any Play Store release.**
3. **Stripe / web checkout path is unverified** — no Stripe keys configured locally.

## 8. Environment / how to reproduce this test

- Root `.env`: `REVENUECAT_ENTITLEMENT_NORMAL=normal_access`,
  `REVENUECAT_ENTITLEMENT_PRO=pro_access`, `REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTHORIZATION=<secret>`.
  The server does **not** call `load_dotenv()` — `run-server.cmd` injects `.env`.
- `app/.env`: `EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_ANDROID_SDK_KEY` / `..._IOS_SDK_KEY` = the Test Store
  key. `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` is inlined at bundle time, so **restart Metro with `--clear`** after
  changing it.
- RevenueCat is a **native module**: it does not work in Expo Go. Use the EAS dev client
  (`npx eas build -p android --profile development`, then `npx eas build:run -p android
  --latest`). JS-only changes need no rebuild; SDK/native changes do — and after a native
  upgrade you **must** restart Metro with `--clear`, or you get
  `RNPurchases.setupPurchases got 8 arguments, expected 10` (new native + stale JS bundle).
- Driving the emulator: see `.agents/skills/rentzu-manual-testing`.
